summary.headline: Mercury Retrograde in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Venus retrograde in Aquarius and Pisces, followed by general effects of Mercury retrograde and its effects in Aries through Scorpio, including illness, weather changes, unrest, market stagnation, errors in medicine and astrology, and dangers to scribes, rulers, soldiers, and nobles.
